scope: Existing terminal receipts only. No guest/process/test/build/network/source actions.
measurementDefinitions: Host elapsed encloses WSB invocation and guest work; pure WSB dispatch time is not recorded.
Supervisor stopwatch starts after child start and is recorded before finally post-binding.
Driver clock starts after common input verification. Timed pre-compile includes context/binding/owner checks, not all child startup.
Semantic receipt elapsed measures the bounded Session operation. It is not the full child elapsed.
Host minus supervisor includes outer pre/post validation plus dispatch/startup/return overhead.
Supervisor minus last driver stage includes startup before stage clock and finalization, not pure startup.
Concurrent UI owner and nested intervals overlap other durations and must not be added.
Upgrade actor elapsed includes pre-validation, installer and post-validation; installer alone is unknown.
minimalProposal: Batch one predetermined consecutive UI-only sequence through one existing guest dispatch while retaining every unchanged per-step supervisor, fresh package/owner checks, one-shot action, deadline, receipt and first-failure stop. No success cache across actions. Measure benefit before wider use.

Add timers around the existing Read-MaintenanceInstalled, Read-MaintenanceNetwork and Read-BackupInventory calls, without extra queries, before attributing cost to file hashing/ACL/CIM or consolidating repeated traversal inside one read-only phase.
Keep reviewed hash-bound DLL reuse limited to the measured compilation component. No causal claim for the pre-reservation timeout.
Optional reuse of dispatch batching for observations at the same state boundary must preserve distinct timestamps, fresh network/probe results and all guards.
Preserve failure cleanup budgets and UNKNOWN handling; no forced UI success or deadline reduction based only on elapsed time.
